items.title: Custom miniature keyboard we're calling it "Hackpad"
items.text:
The image you're looking at is my very first project!

It was built on purpose to use as a dedicated Esc, Ctrl+c, Ctrl+v and Enter but I later reprogrammed it to work as a stopwatch.

The Built files are opensource at : https://github.com/mohammednurulhuda/X1-hackpad-



The PCB is designed in KiCAD.
A 3D printer was used to create the case for the Hackpad, which gives it a sleek and compact design.
This project was a great learning experience.

Honestly electronics is the thing I love!!!
